timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹120.62 Cr (-10.9% YoY), net profit ₹20.79 Cr (-10.7% YoY).
Jai Corp Limited’s Board of Directors, chaired by **Ananjan Datta**, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share on May 30, 2026, excluding 44,600 forfeited shares.
On 23 July 2026, flooding due to heavy rains halted operations at Jai Corp Limited's plastic processing unit in Vasona, Silvassa.
On 11 August 2026, Jai Corp Limited's plastic processing unit at Vasona, Silvassa, fully restarted operations after being halted due to flooding on 23 July 2026.
Jai Corp Limited reported Q1FY27 results with revenue up 20.1% YoY but PAT down 73.0% YoY due to lower other income and higher tax.
